diff --git a/streamjoin/join.py b/streamjoin/join.py
index 0dc2823..5a3b08e 100644
--- a/streamjoin/join.py
+++ b/streamjoin/join.py
@@ -82,3 +82,34 @@ class StreamJoin:
     def _observe(self, event):
         if self._high is None or event.timestamp > self._high:
             self._high = event.timestamp
+            self._evict()
+
+    def _evict(self):
+        if self._high is None:
+            return
+        # Evict events that can no longer participate in any future joins.
+        # An A event at t_a can join only if some C with t_c in [t_a+lower_ab+lower_bc, t_a+upper_ab+upper_bc] arrives.
+        # Since no event arrives before _high - lateness, evict if t_a + upper_ab + upper_bc < _high - lateness.
+        min_a_time = self._high - self.lateness - self.upper_ab - self.upper_bc
+        # B event at t_b can join only if C with t_c in [t_b+lower_bc, t_b+upper_bc] arrives.
+        min_b_time = self._high - self.lateness - self.upper_bc
+        # C event at t_c can join only if new (A, B) pair arrives with compatible times.
+        # New A arrives at >= _high - lateness, needs B in [t_a+lower_ab, t_a+upper_ab],
+        # and B must be in [t_c-upper_bc, t_c-lower_bc]. For intersection: t_a + lower_ab <= t_c - lower_bc.
+        # So t_a <= t_c - lower_ab - lower_bc. For any A >= _high - lateness: need t_c >= _high - lateness + lower_ab + lower_bc.
+        min_c_time = self._high - self.lateness + self.lower_ab + self.lower_bc
+
+        for key in list(self._a.keys()):
+            self._a[key] = [e for e in self._a[key] if e.timestamp >= min_a_time]
+            if not self._a[key]:
+                del self._a[key]
+
+        for key in list(self._b.keys()):
+            self._b[key] = [e for e in self._b[key] if e.timestamp >= min_b_time]
+            if not self._b[key]:
+                del self._b[key]
+
+        for key in list(self._c.keys()):
+            self._c[key] = [e for e in self._c[key] if e.timestamp >= min_c_time]
+            if not self._c[key]:
+                del self._c[key]
